positioning.target_user: Professionals who need to extract, back up, and access LinkedIn connections across devices without manual effort
positioning.job: Extract, sync, and manage LinkedIn connections with cloud backup and multi-device access
positioning.gap: No maintained free and self-hostable alternative covers contact extraction from LinkedIn, cloud sync and backup, search and filter contacts, CSV export, and user registration and login together

items.title: Add a runnable test command for the stated job
items.why: Without one, gate 2's execution loop cannot verify any revival and stops at NEEDS_REVIEW.
items.acceptance: One command runs the tests and exits 0 on a clean checkout.

items.title: Verify backend starts and serves the API on the documented port
items.why: README quick start claims backend runs on http://localhost:300 but the port appears truncated; the job requires a working backend
items.acceptance: cd backend && npm install && npm run dev starts a server that responds to a health endpoint

items.title: Confirm browser extension loads and can authenticate against the local backend
items.why: The stated job includes a browser extension with auto-sync; feasibility calls the project prototype status with no production hardening evidence
items.acceptance: Extension installs in Chrome/Firefox, completes OAuth flow with local backend, and shows a successful sync

items.title: Add automated tests for backend API, frontend components, and extension background scripts
items.why: Feasibility scores 1 citing no test suite; a test suite is needed before any upgrade work
items.acceptance: Test coverage reported for backend routes, React components, and extension message passing; all tests pass in CI
items.quote: provides no evidence of a test suite, CI pipeline, or production hardening; indicates prototype status

items.title: Pin and audit dependencies across backend, frontend, and extension
items.why: Feasibility notes prototype status; dependency drift is a risk for a multi-component system
items.acceptance: npm audit reports no high or critical vulnerabilities; lockfiles committed; dependabot or equivalent configured
items.quote: provides no evidence of a test suite, CI pipeline, or production hardening; indicates prototype status

items.title: Document the OAuth setup for LinkedIn and email/password auth in a single SETUP.md
items.why: README references LinkedIn OAuth ready and email/password auth but SETUP.md exists separately; operators need one authoritative guide
items.acceptance: SETUP.md contains step-by-step LinkedIn developer app creation, callback URLs, JWT secret generation, and first-user registration

items.title: Implement contact extraction from LinkedIn via the browser extension using the documented auto-sync
items.why: Differentiation lists 'Contact extraction from LinkedIn' as a missing capability not covered by any maintained free OSS alternative; the candidate claims auto-sync in the extension
items.acceptance: Extension extracts at least name, headline, company, and profile URL for 1st-degree connections and stores them in the local backend
items.quote: Missing capabilities: 'Contact extraction from LinkedIn', 'Cloud sync and backup', 'Search and filter contacts', 'CSV export', 'User registration and login' (5 not covered by any maintained free OSS alternative)

items.title: Harden cloud sync and backup with conflict resolution and incremental sync
items.why: Differentiation lists 'Cloud sync and backup' as a missing capability; must_beat LeadDelta and n8n workflow offer sync but are not free or self-hostable
items.acceptance: Repeated syncs from multiple devices merge without data loss; backend retains last-synced timestamp per contact
items.quote: Cloud Sync - All contacts backed up to database

items.title: Add search, filter, and CSV export to the web dashboard
items.why: Differentiation lists 'Search and filter contacts' and 'CSV export' as missing capabilities; candidate README claims both are built but feasibility says prototype
items.acceptance: Dashboard shows real-time filtered results as user types; CSV export downloads all visible columns for current filter
items.quote: Missing capabilities: 'Contact extraction from LinkedIn', 'Cloud sync and backup', 'Search and filter contacts', 'CSV export', 'User registration and login' (5 not covered by any maintained free OSS alternative)

items.title: Complete user registration, login, and JWT session management for multi-device access
items.why: Differentiation lists 'User registration and login' as a missing capability; candidate claims both email/password and LinkedIn OAuth ready
items.acceptance: New user can register, verify email, log in on two devices, and see identical contact lists after sync
items.quote: Missing capabilities: 'Contact extraction from LinkedIn', 'Cloud sync and backup', 'Search and filter contacts', 'CSV export', 'User registration and login' (5 not covered by any maintained free OSS alternative)

must_beat.how_to_win: Remain free and self-hostable while delivering auto-sync, enrichment, and export that LeadDelta gates behind a paid tier
Provide a self-hostable, no-code-required alternative that does not depend on Apify credits or Google Sheets
Ship a maintained release with a test suite and CI; the alternative has not been updated in 649 days and has only 2 stars

risks: LinkedIn may block or rate-limit the extraction method used by the browser extension, making the core job unreliable
No external demand signal was found (demand_evidence score 0), so adoption may not justify ongoing maintenance
No structural moat identified (moat score 0); the functionality is replicable and similar tools already exist
Productization path is undefined (score 1): no pricing, target persona definition, or distribution channel

organised.detail: No manifest and no test path in the root: gate 2 would stop at NEEDS_REVIEW until a build and test command exist.

rejected_items.title: Add a test command and CI pipeline so the round-trip job is verifiable
rejected_items.reason: quote not found verbatim in the cited evidence
